title: Platform Control Centre, Data Settings & Tool Catalogue
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.15 — Research Reporting & Publication Command Centre
database_migration: No schema changes. Backup/restore and migration utilities preserve all existing scientific stores.
headline_features: Platform Control Centre for data sources, storage, connections, databases, backups, preferences, diagnostics and migration.
SQLite-consistent verified backup packages and typed-confirmation scientific-database restore with pre-restore recovery backup.
Metadata-only Data Library and country climate workspace inventory.
Safe cache-management controls that exclude user scientific data.
Persistent optional backend paths and platform preferences.
Searchable All Tools catalogue with maturity/data-requirement labels, favourites, recent tools and context suggestions.
limitations: Full interactive browser verification requires the target Streamlit environment.
Database restore intentionally does not restore climate datasets/attachments; use the full migration utility for complete installation migration.
External network availability is evaluated only when the user explicitly performs a retrieval/test.
